chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said regarding the description of the believer:

The believer has cheerfulness in his face and sorrow in his heart; he is the broadest of chests and the most humble of selves. He dislikes high position and detests renown. His grief is long, his concern is far-reaching, his silence is frequent, and his time is occupied. He is grateful, patient, immersed in his thoughts, sparing in his friendship, easy in constitution, soft in temperament. His soul is harder than stone, yet he is humbler than a slave.

key_terms.أَذَلُّ شَيْءٍ نَفْسًا: Most humble of selves (modest and lowly in status)
key_terms.أَصْلَبُ مِنَ الصَّلْدِ: Harder than stone (referring to the soul's resilience)
key_terms.أَوْسَعُ شَيْءٍ صَدْرًا: Broadest of chests (indicating generosity and capacity)
key_terms.بِشْرُهُ: Cheerfulness or brightness in the face
key_terms.حُزْنُهُ: Sorrow or deep contemplation in the heart
key_terms.ضَنِينٌ بِخَلَّتِهِ: Sparing in his friendship or companionship

ai.seo_question: What are the key spiritual and ethical traits of a believer according to Imam Ali in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) delineates the believer's character as a synthesis of outward humility and inward resilience, a concept central to Shia ethical theology where the self is simultaneously subdued to avoid arrogance yet fortified against spiritual weakness. This description emphasizes that true piety involves concealing one's devotion from ostentation while maintaining a broad chest for endurance, reflecting the Prophetic tradition of *zuhd* (asceticism) combined with *shaja'ah* (courage).

en.sayed-ali-raza: 333. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said describing a believer:

A believer has a cheerful face, a sorrowful heart, a very broad chest (full of generosity), and a very humble heart. He hates high position and dislikes renown. His grief is long, his courage is far-reaching, his silence is much and, his time is occupied. He is grateful, enduring, buried in his thoughts, sparing in his friendship (with others), of bright demeanour and of soft temperament. He is stronger than stone but humbler than a slave.
